candidate_relations.reason: Widespread double-edged plaques and bamboo hair are not seborrheic dermatitis.
Monilethrix is a related beaded hair-shaft disorder, not invaginate/bamboo hair of Netherton.
Alopecia/hair breakage is a manifestation of the shaft defect, not the syndrome name.
The morphology is ichthyosis linearis circumflexa, not lichen planus.
Pityriasis rubra pilaris lacks trichorrhexis invaginata.
Near-erythrodermic involvement can mimic psoriasis but conflicts with the hair-shaft diagnosis.
Atopic dermatitis is a phenotypic component of Netherton but misses ichthyosis linearis circumflexa and bamboo hair.
Ichthyosis is the parent skin phenotype without the syndromic hair finding.
Discoid lupus does not explain polycyclic double-edged scale and trichorrhexis invaginata.
